```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Game lines only from the complete seasons, so the season still being played
# does not change the band means.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
pos <- signature_positions(collect(tbl(con, "roster")))
pg <- collect(tbl(con, "player_game")) |>
  filter(season <= complete_through)
game_values <- signature_game_values(build_game_production(pg), pos)
grad <- band_gradient(game_values)

p <- grad |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      group,
      ", ",
      band,
      ": ",
      fmt(mean_yds, 1),
      " yards (SD ",
      fmt(sd_yds, 1),
      ") over ",
      fmt(games),
      " games"
    )
  ) |>
  # Reversed, so the weakest band sits at the top and unrated opponents last.
  ggplot(aes(forcats::fct_rev(band), mean_yds, fill = group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip), width = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Does yardage fall against stronger opponents?",
    subtitle = "Mean yards per game by opponent Elo band, with one standard deviation either side",
    x = "Opponent band",
    y = "Mean yards per game",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "yardage-by-opponent-strength", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: drop-table
# The drop from the weakest to the strongest rated band, the figure's headline
# number. Unrated opponents have no Elo, so they are not the weakest band.
band_drop(grad) |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    `Yards lost per game` = fmt(drop, 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Position group", "Yards lost per game"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Mean yards per game lost from the under 1400 band to the 1800 and up band, over the seasons through ",
      complete_through,
      "."
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: card-footer
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat(card_footer())
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
